sections.title: Learning Objectives
sections.text: Understand ENSO phases, ocean-atmosphere interaction, and Monterey Bay effects.

sections.title: El Niño Basics
sections.text: El Niño is the warm phase of ENSO, with warmer central and eastern equatorial Pacific surface waters.

sections.title: ENSO: Three Phases
sections.text: El Niño, neutral, and La Niña are the three ENSO phases.

sections.title: ENSO Explained
sections.text: Tropical Pacific winds, sea temperatures, and circulation interact and reinforce changes.

sections.title: Trade Winds & Walker Circulation
sections.text: Easterly trade winds normally push warm water west; they often weaken during El Niño.

sections.title: Ocean & Atmosphere
sections.text: Weaker trade winds allow warm water to move east and reduce equatorial eastern Pacific upwelling.

sections.title: Equatorial Kelvin Waves
sections.text: Downwelling equatorial Kelvin waves travel east and deepen the eastern Pacific thermocline.

sections.title: Super El Niño
sections.text: Super El Niño is an informal description of unusually strong events, not a formal classification.

sections.title: Monterey Bay Impacts
sections.text: Monterey Bay may experience changes in temperature, nutrients, species, and storm conditions.

sections.title: Marine Impacts
sections.text: Changing ocean temperatures and food webs can shift fish, seabirds, and marine mammals.

sections.title: Coastal Impacts
sections.text: Strong waves, tides, and storms can combine to increase erosion or coastal flooding.

sections.title: Economic Impacts
sections.text: Fisheries, tourism, infrastructure, and communities can experience varying impacts.

sections.title: Impacts at MBA
sections.text: Aquarium guides can connect ENSO to upwelling, temperature, marine food webs, and observations.

sections.title: Central California
sections.text: Local winds and upwelling influence Central California alongside broader ENSO conditions.

sections.title: Guest FAQs
sections.text: El Niño changes climate probabilities but does not guarantee rain or individual storms.

sections.title: Combating Doom-ism
sections.text: Discuss risks with evidence, uncertainty, preparation, and practical agency.

sections.title: El Niño Quick Facts
sections.text: ENSO monitoring combines ocean temperature measurements and atmospheric indicators.

sections.title: Current Conditions
sections.text: Current conditions are not displayed until a dated, verified official update is available.
